import Mathlib

inductive BinarySearchTree : Type
| Empty : BinarySearchTree
| Node : Int → BinarySearchTree → BinarySearchTree → BinarySearchTree

def view (t : BinarySearchTree) : Set Int :=
  match t with
  | BinarySearchTree.Empty => ∅
  | BinarySearchTree.Node v l r => view l ∪ view r ∪ {v}

def is_bst (t : BinarySearchTree) : Prop :=
  match t with
  | BinarySearchTree.Empty => True
  | BinarySearchTree.Node v l r =>
    (∀ x ∈ view l, x < v) ∧
    is_bst l ∧
    (∀ x ∈ view r, x > v) ∧
    is_bst r

-- Precondition definitions
@[reducible, simp]
def search_precond (t : BinarySearchTree) (v : Int) : Prop :=
  -- !benchmark @start precond
  is_bst t
  -- !benchmark @end precond

-- !benchmark @start auxcode
def bstSearch (t : BinarySearchTree) (v : Int) : Bool :=
  match t with
  | BinarySearchTree.Empty => false
  | BinarySearchTree.Node x l r =>
    if v < x then
      bstSearch l v
    else if v > x then
      bstSearch r v
    else
      true
-- !benchmark @end auxcode

-- Main function definition
def search (t : BinarySearchTree) (v : Int)
    (h_precond : search_precond t v) : Bool :=
  -- !benchmark @start code
  bstSearch t v
  -- !benchmark @end code

-- Postcondition definitions
@[reducible, simp]
def search_postcond (t : BinarySearchTree) (v : Int) (result : Bool)
    (_ : search_precond t v) : Prop :=
  -- !benchmark @start postcond
  result = (v ∈ view t)
  -- !benchmark @end postcond

-- !benchmark @start lemma
theorem bstSearch_correct :
    ∀ t : BinarySearchTree, is_bst t →
      ∀ v : Int, bstSearch t v = true ↔ v ∈ view t := by
  intro t
  induction t with
  | Empty =>
      intro h v
      simp [bstSearch, view]
  | Node x l r ihl ihr =>
      intro h v
      change
        (∀ y ∈ view l, y < x) ∧
        is_bst l ∧
        (∀ y ∈ view r, y > x) ∧
        is_bst r at h
      rcases h with ⟨hl_order, hl_bst, hr_order, hr_bst⟩
      by_cases hlt : v < x
      · have hnotr : v ∉ view r := by
          intro hv
          have hright : v > x := hr_order v hv
          omega
        have hne : v ≠ x := by
          omega
        simp [bstSearch, view, hlt, ihl hl_bst v, hnotr, hne]
      · by_cases hgt : v > x
        · have hnotl : v ∉ view l := by
            intro hv
            have hleft : v < x := hl_order v hv
            omega
          have hne : v ≠ x := by
            omega
          simp [bstSearch, view, hlt, hgt, ihr hr_bst v, hnotl, hne]
        · have heq : v = x := by
            omega
          simp [bstSearch, view, hlt, hgt, heq]
-- !benchmark @end lemma

-- Proof content
theorem search_postcond_satisfied (t : BinarySearchTree) (v : Int)
    (h_precond : search_precond t v) :
    search_postcond t v (search t v h_precond) h_precond := by
  -- !benchmark @start proof
  change (bstSearch t v : Prop) = (v ∈ view t)
  apply propext
  exact bstSearch_correct t h_precond v
  -- !benchmark @end proof
